title: Uncharted Ruin
text: Rumbagh has setup camp at this ruin to uncover it's secrets. A skilled scholar could help him with his research in exchange for doubloons, or use the research to create study journals.

title: Silkmoth Breeding Ground
text: A breeding ground for Silkmoths. Skilled tailors could create silk in the area by capturing silkmoths and harvesting their cocoons. Silk can be exchanged for doubloons or recrafted into cloth.

title: Shipwreck
text: A shipwreck has washed ashore with various activities for Carpenters and Smiths to complete. Salvage pirate's weapons at the nearby structures or repair shipwheels with the debris scattered on the beach.

title: Savory Bountiful Berry Bush
text: A massive berry bush grows here. Treat it with some water to collect berries and citric berries!

title: Hexite Deposit
text: A massive hexite deposit which Empires could use to fund their empire as well as conflicts with other empires. This can only be harvested by the empire that controls the area.

title: Sealed Hexite Vault
text: A massive vault that contains Uncharted Doubloons as well as various trinkets and fruits. This vault periodically activates and it's locks can be broken by using the crystals from the crabs in the area.

title: Volcanic Geyser
text: A volcanic geyser where you could cook volcanic bricks made from the volcanic rock in the area.

title: Zesty Bountiful Berry Bush
text: A massive berry bush grows here. Treat it with some water to collect berries and citric berries!

title: Basic Bountiful Berry Bush
text: A massive berry bush grows here. Treat it with some water to collect berries and citric berries!

title: Forgotten Quarry
text: A forgotten quarry that contains stone that could be mined for better rewards.

title: Maker's Tree
text: A tree that drops various powerful fruits. This tree can only be harvested by the Empire that owns the land.

title: Overgrown Mine
text: An overgrown mine that contains special roots that could be harvested by a carpenter. A skilled mason could repair the bridges and archways in here to keep them open for the carpenter to work.

title: Hermit Crab Den and Boot Fish School
text: This area contains a hermit crab den for hunters to trap hermit crabs. Additionally, there's a school of fish with boots on their head in the water for leatherworkers to fish up and salvage the boots.
